entities.name: Lucio Manuel Moreno Quintana
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lucio Manuel Moreno Quintana was an Argentine lawyer and diplomat. He was a member of the Permanent Court of Arbitration and a judge of the International Court of Justice (ICJ). He was the first of two Argentine judges in the history of the ICJ.
